## Tutorials

The MICROSECOND() function returns the microsecond part of a time/datetime (from 0 to 
999999).

### Code Examples

```
SELECT MICROSECOND("2017-06-20 09:34:00.000023");

---

MICROSECOND(
datetime
)

---

SELECT MICROSECOND("23:59:59.000045");
```

## Tutorials

The MINUTE() function returns the minute part of a time/datetime (from 0 to 
59).

### Code Examples

```
SELECT MINUTE("2017-06-20 09:34:00");

---

MINUTE(
datetime
)

---

SELECT MINUTE("23:59:59");
```

## Tutorials

The MONTH() function returns the month part for a given date (a number from 1 to 
12).

### Code Examples

```
SELECT MONTH("2017-06-15");

---

MONTH(
date
)

---

SELECT MONTH("2017-06-15 09:34:21");

---

SELECT MONTH(CURDATE());
```

## Tutorials

The MONTHNAME() function returns the name of the month for a given date.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT MONTHNAME("2017-06-15");

---

MONTHNAME(
date
)

---

SELECT MONTHNAME("2017-06-15 09:34:21");

---

SELECT MONTHNAME(CURDATE());
```

## Tutorials

The NOW() function returns the current date and time.

Note:The date and time is returned as "YYYY-MM-DD HH-MM-SS" 
(string) or as YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.uuuuuu (numeric).

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  NOW();

---

NOW()

---

SELECT 
  NOW() + 1;
```
